$comment: Offline typecheck config. This sandbox/CI image has no npm registry access, so
node_modules (and therefore the real react/next types) cannot be installed.
This config swaps in the loose stubs from .offline-types/ so that `tsc` can still
catch real mistakes in our own source. Use the normal tsconfig.json whenever
ONE DELIBERATE DIFFERENCE FROM tsconfig.json: `jsx` is 'react-jsx' here, not
'preserve'. With 'preserve', tsc resolves the JSX namespace in a way our stubs
cannot satisfy, and every component with a required `children` prop reports a
false 'Property children is missing'. 'react-jsx' resolves the namespace from
react/jsx-runtime, which .offline-types/react.d.ts declares. This affects type
resolution only — no code is emitted (noEmit) — so it does not change the build.
The real tsconfig.json keeps 'preserve', which is what Next.js requires.
